title: dep-scan serve output
description: The document `depscan serve --format json` writes on stdout once the server is listening, and the only content stdout ever carries: the host and port the server was configured with, and the URL a client can reach it on. Request logs go to stderr. A server that cannot start produces the error document instead.

host.description: The host the server was configured with, as given.

port.description: The TCP port the server listens on.

url.description: The URL a client can reach the server on, http://<host>:<port> with the unspecified addresses 0.0.0.0 and :: shown as 127.0.0.1. An IPv6 host is written in brackets.
